doubts.claim_under_doubt: the all-projects read deduplicates registrations that share one reminder store
doubts.disproof_attempt: The dedupe key resolveMainCheckout only recognises a linked-worktree .git file; nested registrations or differently-cased paths read the same store twice.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Dedupe reminder items by the CLI's reminderStore field.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: the all-projects read spawns at most 3 children
doubts.disproof_attempt: The limit is per request; several tabs or a cross-site GET multiply spawns.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Process-wide semaphore, in-flight coalescing, refuse cross-site GET.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: untrusted text cannot become a live link
doubts.disproof_attempt: The read path passes javascript: url refs and file refs through.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Neutralise non-http(s) url refs in the contract parser.

doubts.disproof_attempt: A blocklist of uv phrasings is fragile; a distinct CLI exit code would be better.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: argv survives Node, uv and python on Windows
doubts.disproof_attempt: Embedded quotes, trailing backslashes and a lone -- title not probed.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: no state reads as nothing due
doubts.disproof_attempt: Non-Shipwright projects are permanently degraded; one bad item makes the whole project unreadable.

summary: 0 high, 3 medium, 3 low. The three mediums were fixed in the commit after 5d9d9343 (store-keyed dedupe, global cap + coalescing + cross-site refusal, url neutralising); the argv probe was added; the exit-2 marker and the lows are carried to the operator/W2.
